headline: Make his video easy to evaluate
caption:
Is your player putting together a recruiting video? Make it easy for a college coach to evaluate.

Coaches often watch a lot of video in a short time. If the first few seconds don't show them what they need, they may move on.

✅ Show his position and name right away
✅ Put his key numbers on screen (exit velo, 60 time, velo, pop time)
✅ Use clear, steady footage from a good angle
❌ Don't open with a long intro or highlight-reel music
❌ Don't hide his jersey number

Numbers help a coach see where he fits, but only if they're easy to find.

Do you know where his numbers stack up by level?

See what the numbers say about your player's best fit:

caption_4pm:
Recruiting video tip for baseball parents: the easier it is to evaluate, the better.

A college coach may only give a video a few seconds before deciding to keep watching.

✅ Lead with his position and name
✅ Show his key numbers on screen: exit velo, 60 time, velo or pop time
✅ Keep the camera steady and the angle clear
❌ Skip the long intro and the loud music
❌ Don't let his jersey number get lost

Good video plus honest numbers helps coaches see his best fit.
